api_key.description: Overmind API key. Can also be set via the OVERMIND_API_KEY environment variable.

app_url.description: Overmind application URL (e.g. https://app.overmind.tech). Can also be set via the OVERMIND_APP_URL environment variable.

block.description: The Overmind provider manages infrastructure sources via the Overmind API. Configuration is read from the OVERMIND_API_KEY and OVERMIND_APP_URL environment variables by default.

aws_regions.description: AWS regions this source should discover resources in.

aws_role_arn.description: ARN of the IAM role to assume in the customer's AWS account.

external_id.description: AWS STS external ID for the IAM trust policy, stable per Overmind account.

id.description: Source UUID assigned by the Overmind API.

block.description: Manages an Overmind AWS infrastructure source.

external_id.description: AWS STS external ID, stable per Overmind account.

block.description: Retrieves the stable AWS STS external ID for the current Overmind account. Use this to configure the trust policy on an IAM role before creating the source.
